items.description: Scoopmap.net allows users to view breaking news around the world by leveraging two APIs. Discover hot spots and articles written by high quality newspapers such as the Guardian and New York Times.
A Mashup of the new WikiLocation API and Google Maps to show information about Wikipedia articles in a location.

DBpedia Mobile maps DBpedia locations and allows users to explore background information about them by navigating into DBpedia and other interlinked datasets such as GeoNames, Revyu, EuroStat and Flickr. Supports 14 languages and various filters.

For each of the 1.95 million DBpedia concepts, the wrappr generates a collection of flickr photos that depict the concept, utilizing multilingual labels and geo-coordinates provided in Wikipedia entries.
A community to search, rate, and review local restaurants or find a new place to eat.

A map of contributions to 2006 Massachusetts gubernatorial campaigns. Uses the Google Maps API and data from the Massachusetts Office of Campaign and Political finance. One of the most extensive use of data with layering on Google Maps.
Aanbieding is the leading discount app in The Netherlands.
Twitalyzer is for tracking influence and measuring success in Twitter. It evaluates your Twitter activity in five categories: influence, signal-to-noise ratio, generosity, velocity and clout.
Plan, share, and discover new walking routes.
cardiff.gov.uk list of 10,000 businesses in Cardiff plotted onto a map of the city grouped by business type.
A Pentomino Puzzle. It is created by using the OpenLayers Mapping API. Move, rotate and reflect the 12 pieces to find a solution for the rectangles layout.
A Java-based Flickr backup utility that lets you back up all your photos on Flickr.
CNN Money list of the top 10 most expensive colleges in the United States. Not necessarily the ones you would expect.

Find Tesco store locations on a Virtual Earth map of the UK with an optional satellite image overlay. Hover the mouse over a location to get directions, or click on the name of the store to view its address, phone number and store hours.
Nexmo can send a SMS message to each mobile number in a CSV file. Built with itDuzzit, a platform that offers pre-built integration and connectors for dozens of cloud (web) applications.

MSpider.net aims to help many different types of music lovers to explore music; one user can explore music of different regions or types, another might be curious to hear music related to an artist that he/she enjoys and another may want to generate a jukebox to play background music at the office. Because the music is located on youTube this creates an opportunity to find a wide range of results (interviews, live events, singles etc.). Users create stations to store their compilations and can share stations with their 'friends' by posting links on their facebook timeline.
Google map of TB patient Andrew Speaker's journey across the Atlantic.
Send order confirmations, delivery notices, stock changes or other updates via SMS to your Shopify customers. Built using Mediaburst SMS and Shopify APIs.
Site builds a web cloud based off content which ties directly to a product search using the Amazon Search API.
HomeWebShop.com is an online shopping site that combines Google Maps and Amazon.com shopping services.
This gadget grabs the Yahoo weather feed for any US zip code or international country code, and updates an object to display the current weather in Second Life.
Crowdsourcing happy hour specials in NYC with SMS and Twitter.
Create Online Memorials and Share them with your Facebook Friends and Family

A Virtual Earth ajax client for locating Gym Alliance fitness clubs. Has search, direction control, the table updates when you mouse-over the club pushpins. If you click through to a specific club, it also provides driving directions.
An easy interface to search for Flickr images. Includes advanced options to search by license type or date posted.
Provides tracking information of UPS packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
There are literally thousands of hotels across the world employing green policies of some kind, but these hotels truly represent the best of green culture.
Real-time HTML/CSS/Javascript editor and advanced Search Engine dedicated to web development and design.
A very fun Flickr game in which you view a set of ten images and try to guess the common tag. Time based scoring.
Online passport and visa photo service that provides guaranteed government compliance based on sophisticated biometrics.
Automate your SEO reporting in Excel without programming.

At Sea Scotia Vacation Rentals we want you to have the Nova Scotia Vacation of a lifetime. We have some of the finest Nova Scotia Cottages and Nova Scotia Vacation rentals. All locations are listed on the map.
A mashup of Google My Maps, biographical information from the Web, Google books, and other content.
A concept that can be summed up by the equation: map plus timeline equals resume. Create yours. It Uses the MIT Simile Timeline JavaScript component.
A numerical ranking based on popularity of country music artists.

A widget that uses Zazzle's Store Builder API to create a custom display of a contributor's most popular or most recently created Zazzle products. Display results from a single Zazzle gallery, a single product line, or the entire Zazzle marketpl
Our Sun Sign, Mind, Body and Yoga are all interconnected. Your Zodiac Sign, Health and Yoga is a Faceook app which helps to explore Health and Yoga based on Zodiac signs.
PrintCentral is a mobile printing app for the iPhone. Using its integration with Box.net, users are now able to access and print their Box files from within PrintCentral.
Remote Review allows you to have an online conversation. The drag and drop file sharing feature makes sure both parties (or all of you) are on the same page.

LyricStatus allows you to share your favorite lyrics with your Facebook friends. Simply highlight your favorite lines from a song and post straight to Facebook as a status. You can post lyrics to your own wall, or you can utilize the Facebook Graph API to post to your friends' wall.
View mutual connections across Facebook, Twitter, and Linkedin.
Lets you search for flights and see the current location plotted on a Google Map.

CallCollector is a virtual voicemail box to collect calls from fans, customers, groups, or whatever you need it for. A business may use it as a complaint & feedback line. A talk radio station may use it to allow listeners to vent to (or about) their on-air personalities. You might even use it to collect wishes from family all over the county and stitch them together for a relative's birthday or anniversary.

integrate The Raiser’s Edge, with your email marketing using the Springbaud email management solution, by Protégé Solutions. Once the Springbaud plug-in is installed, you can upload lists to Campaign Monitor and retrieve results from sent campaigns, all from within The Raiser’s Edge.
